purpose: Separate authoritative market-rule observations from broker, account, product and actual-execution facts for all ten U0 domestic classes. This is not legal advice, an account-opening guide, a product admission, an allocation, a holding, an order or an investment action.

boundary.t0_t1_definition: T+0/T+1 labels describe the documented round-trip or settlement mechanism only. They do not guarantee liquidity, fillability, price, withdrawal timing or market access.
boundary.rule_vs_entitlement: An exchange or regulatory rule can establish a market mechanism but cannot prove an individual's account permission, broker support, live fee, margin add-on, order acceptance or fill.
boundary.freeze_requirement: Every product/contract rule must be verified again at the formal freeze date using the then-effective venue rule, product legal document, broker agreement, account status and raw evidence.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: Treat as next-session resale unless a dated product/venue rule explicitly allows round-trip. Direct A shares must not be modeled as a generic T+0 instrument.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: Base SSE competitive buy order is 100 shares/units; STAR, ChiNext and BSE have board-specific order rules. Generic 10% SSE price control is not universal: STAR and ChiNext use 20% frameworks, BSE 30%, and new-listing/delisting exceptions exist.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Not applicable as a base cash-equity trade; financing/securities-lending requires separate permission and ledger.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: Main-board account access is not evidence of board, margin, securities-lending or broker order-route access.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Limit prices, halts, special status, board rules, no fill and auction/session constraints can prevent exit.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Listings, delistings, halts, resumptions, distributions, rights, splits, mergers and tax/settlement must be dated events.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: SZSE investor education describes on-market infrastructure-fund purchases as sellable on T+1. REITs are closed-end listed funds and are not assumed to have ETF primary-market redemption.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: SZSE REIT guide states 100 units or integer multiples, odd-lot exit and 0.001 price increment. Venue materials describe a 30% listing-day and 10% subsequent-day price-control framework, subject to current-rule recheck.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: No option exercise. Transfer, custody, fund-platform and pledge/repo routes are distinct and not assumed.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: First participation requires risk disclosure/suitability matching, but individual account route and permissions remain unverified.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Liquidity-service provision does not guarantee fill; price-limit, temporary-halt, strategic lock-up, expansion and event notices matter.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Underlying-operating events, expansion, related-party events, lock-up release, ownership disclosure and fund termination/transfer rules are material.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: SSE ETF Q&A states stock ETFs use T+1. Secondary trading and primary creation/redemption are distinct.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: ETF minimum secondary-market trade is 100 units and tick is 0.001, subject to product/venue rules.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: No exercise. Creation/redemption basket, cash substitution and unit size need product-level confirmation.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: A securities or fund account route does not prove a particular ETF, creation/redemption service or broker order type is accessible.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Market price, NAV, IOPV, constituent-market state, premium/discount, fund halt and creation/redemption halt may diverge.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Distribution, split, liquidation, termination, index-methodology and constituent-rebalance events must be retained.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: SSE ETF Q&A lists bond and money-market ETFs among categories supporting T+0; the bond-ETF guide notes same-day mechanisms may depend on broker technical readiness.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: General ETF 100-unit and 0.001 tick facts apply only subject to the contemporaneous fund/venue rule.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: No exercise. Pledge/repo, creation/redemption and collateral are separate services with their own permissions.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: A listed-fund account does not prove repo, primary-market, collateral or every bond/money ETF permission.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Market price and NAV can diverge; trading, creation and redemption can be halted separately.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Interest, distribution, share adjustment, termination and underlying credit events require an event ledger.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: SSE ETF Q&A names gold ETFs among categories supporting T+0. Other commodity ETF mechanisms cannot be inferred from their label and need product-specific verification.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: Use ETF 100-unit and 0.001 tick only where the current product/venue rules confirm them.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: No option exercise. Cash/physical basket, custody and redemption terms are product-specific.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: General fund-account availability does not prove product, redemption or cross-venue access.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: ETF market price, NAV, underlying-market hours/holidays, custody valuation and creation/redemption constraints can diverge.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Fund suspension, share adjustment, termination and underlying custody/valuation events are material.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: Bond settlement and same-day resale depend on venue, trade method and offering type. SSE public convertible bonds are in same-day multilateral net settlement; this cannot be generalized to every bond.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: SSE public convertible-bond matching is in 1,000 yuan face-value increments. Listing-day limits are +57.3%/-43.3% and subsequently 20%, with temporary-halt rules. Other bonds and venues require their own current rules.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Convertible bonds have conversion, put/call, redemption, maturity and interest events; bonds may have coupon, principal, credit and settlement events.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: Specific-object convertible transfer has a professional-investor boundary. Individual eligibility for a particular bond/route is not inferred.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: No continuous quotes, temporary halt, stopped trading, conversion/redemption window and credit event can block exit.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Corporate conversion-price adjustments, stop-trading, conversion, redemption, put, coupon and maturity must be dated.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: Use venue/session/contract-specific intraday close handling, not stock T+1. Daily mark-to-market, including close-today P&L mechanics in some rules, is distinct from cash-securities settlement.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: Multiplier, tick, price limit, margin, position limit and transaction limit are product/contract/date-specific. Exchanges may adjust them for risk.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Daily margin, variation margin, forced liquidation and physical or cash delivery are mandatory accounting states.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: Futures-company account, suitability, contract permission, broker route and delivery capability must be externally confirmed.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Limit-move no-fill, margin increase, restricted opening, forced reduction, session disruption and delivery proximity can prevent exit.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Contract listing, expiry, delivery, rule/parameter change, holiday schedule and warehouse/receipt rules must be retained.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: CFFEX uses margin and daily mark-to-market; cash-equity T+1 assumptions do not apply. Exact day-session and close-today treatment must be captured by contract and broker.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: CFFEX price controls, margin, limits, transaction limits and forced-liquidation controls are product-specific and may be adjusted.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Daily margin and either cash settlement or product-specific delivery/expiry events are required.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: CFFEX suitability system and broker product permission must be independently evidenced.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Limit moves, higher margin, restricted opening/withdrawal, forced closure/reduction and no-fill are possible.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Contract expiry, settlement, rule changes, trade-limit notices and calendar changes need a dated ledger.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: Stock, financial-futures and commodity-futures options have separate trading, exercise and settlement rules. A stock-option exercise settlement is next session under SSE rules; do not equate exercise with an ordinary close.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: Contract units, strikes, expiry, price limits and adjustment terms are contract-specific and can change for corporate actions.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Buyers pay premium; sellers/covered writers face margin or underlying-lock requirements. Exercise needs sufficient contracts/underlying/funds and can lead to assignment or specified cash settlement.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: SSE suitability guidance requires assessment, knowledge/simulation and tiered permissions. No individual permission, selling-open authority or strategy-level access is assumed.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Wide/no quotes, contract halt, expiry, adjustment, assignment, front-end control and insufficient exercise assets can block the intended path.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Expired-chain retention, contract adjustment, exercise/assignment and underlying corporate-action synchronization are mandatory.

class_matrix.roundtrip_and_settlement: No class-wide domestic product population or unified mechanism has been verified. No T+0/T+1 conclusion is allowed.
class_matrix.unit_and_price_controls: If a specific product is verified as an exchange-listed fund, its current product and venue rules—not ordinary ETF inference—govern units and prices.
class_matrix.margin_exercise_delivery: Leverage, inverse payoff, reset, derivatives, financing, creation/redemption and collateral are product-specific.
class_matrix.suitability_and_access: No personal access conclusion is available.
class_matrix.liquidity_restrictions: Depth, maker support, reset, suspension, liquidation and path dependence must be separately evidenced.
class_matrix.delisting_and_corporate_actions: Product termination, reset, adjustment, underlying derivative and valuation events require a dedicated ledger.

failure_state_rule: No quote, price-limit no-fill, halt, missing permission, delivery proximity, insufficient margin, insufficient exercise assets, lock-up, failed settlement or unknown rule version must create an explicit failure state. The formal replay must not substitute a favorable price, delay without rule support or treat the event as a zero-cost close.
